'''2007 Worlds Team Chris Menzel DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Jetlag. Typed DS Combat V13.01. Gall system as written.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
